name: Coleraine Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Coleraine Community Centre. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Causeway Coast and Glens Council Allotments
short_description: Council allotment sites in Coleraine area
description: Council manages sites at Ballycastle Road and Millburn. Plots from £20/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Coleraine Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Christie Park. Grows seasonal vegetables and potatoes with harvest shared among volunteers. Irish heritage varieties grown.
